title: "Failed to create log directory" and "Failed to get logging directory" in ROS 2: non-root Docker users, HOME, ROS_LOG_DIR and ros2 launch, measured
excerpt: Why rclpy, rclcpp, ros2 launch and the ros2 CLI fail at startup when ~/.ros/log can't be created: unwritable or unset HOME, a root-owned ~/.ros, and which fixes worked (ROS_LOG_DIR, ROS_HOME, --disable-external-lib-logs). Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
